children: Tencent's stock is likely near its trough valuation, Goldman Sachs analysts say in a research note. Although its 2Q results exacerbate near-term earnings concerns, management's comments indicate that its capex intensity has peaked with compute prepayments set to decline now, they note. Meanwhile, its AI products have shown early monetization evidence across the AI work assistant Workbuddy, Weixin-embedded AI agent Xiaowei and the cloud segment, they note. The analysts think the company's peaking free cash flow outflow should ease some pressure on its valuation, especially after its shares have lost over 40% so far this year. Tencent's shares are down 1.4% at 343.40 Hong Kong dollars. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
